name: Lynch Syndrome

criteria.description: At least three relatives with Lynch syndrome-associated cancers, one of whom is a first-degree relative of the other two
Involvement of at least two successive generations
At least one Lynch syndrome-associated cancer diagnosed before age 50
Tumor demonstrating microsatellite instability or loss of mismatch repair protein expression

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria must be met for clinical diagnosis; tumor testing supports diagnosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for mismatch repair gene mutations confirms diagnosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mismatch repair deficiency in tumor tissue
pathognomonic.notes: Detected by immunohistochemistry or MSI testing

common.notes: Increased risk compared to general population

common.symptomName: Urothelial carcinoma of the upper urinary tract
common.notes: Includes renal pelvis and ureter cancers

rare.notes: Rare skin tumors in Muir-Torre syndrome

laboratory: Microsatellite instability (MSI) testing positive in tumor tissue
Immunohistochemistry showing loss of mismatch repair proteins (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2)
imaging: Colonoscopy revealing colorectal tumors or adenomas
Pelvic ultrasound or MRI for endometrial or ovarian tumors
genetic: Germline pathogenic variants in mismatch repair genes: MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2, EPCAM
other: Family history of Lynch syndrome-associated cancers
Histopathology showing tumor infiltrating lymphocytes and mucinous features

distinguishingFeatures: Hundreds to thousands of colorectal adenomatous polyps
Subset of Lynch syndrome with skin manifestations

redFlags: Multiple family members with Lynch syndrome-associated cancers
Presence of mismatch repair deficiency in tumor tissue
references: Lynch HT, de la Chapelle A. Hereditary colorectal cancer. N Engl J Med. 2003 Mar 6;348(10):919-32.
Vasen HF, Blanco I, Aktan-Collan K, et al. Revised guidelines for the clinical management of Lynch syndrome (HNPCC): recommendations by a group of European experts. Gut. 2013 Jun;62(6):812-23.
Boland CR, Goel A. Microsatellite instability in colorectal cancer. Gastroenterology. 2010 Jun;138(6):2073-87.e3.
